title: get specific: a thumbs up teaches SocialUs a member's taste

criteria.text: A thumbs up on every card (Explore, search, Page, post, chat answers) meaning "more like this": one tap, tap again to undo; not a save, notifies no one, subscribes to nothing
criteria.note: Not built: no thumbs-up control, table or handler [V grep src, migrations]. The heart (#1172) is not this: a Page's managers see who hearted, by name [V src/ontology/links.ts]. Needs the PM: does the thumbs up replace the heart or sit beside it?

criteria.text: Labels behind the scenes: every Page, post and listing gets labels from one small model call on its words and photos when posted or edited; the owner sees and can fix them; no member types one; no label shows on a card
criteria.note: Not built: posts carry owner-chosen labels from a shared list (`post_tags`, #1180), not model-assigned ones [V post.ts]. Depends on the item-tag dictionary, #1318 (F092, open).

criteria.text: Thumbs up are never listed for the member to manage; each counts toward the labels of what was tapped and fades (start at a 60-day half-life)
The summary in You: "Seems you're into", shown once enough agree (start at 5 thumbs up sharing a label over 2 or more days); each line "That's me" or "Not really"
criteria.note: Not built: nothing on You [V src/app/you].

criteria.text: Discover, Home shelves (F121) and the Ask bar lean toward the summary and recent thumbs up; Find's plain order and search relevance do not change
criteria.note: Not built: nothing ranks by a taste signal [V grep].

criteria.text: One switch off ("I don't mind doing this myself") stops learning and deletes the thumbs up and the summary
criteria.note: Not built: #1172's body says the F113 off switch is not built; the search-sharing opt-out (#923) is a different switch [V].

criteria.text: Nobody else sees it: no member, Page owner or visitor can read anyone's thumbs up or summary (a test proves it, seen failing first); no Page learns who gave one; builder accounts count nowhere
criteria.note: Not built: nothing to guard yet [V].

criteria.text: Never from opens, views, time spent or scrolling
criteria.note: Not built: no learning exists; absence proves nothing until a standing guard does [V].

criteria.text: Two weekly numbers on the PM's dashboard: the share of summary lines marked "That's me", and how often an answer after a thumbs up leads to an act; counts only
